idea: The one habit that fixed my mornings
text:
What if I told you one thing changes everything at dawn? [pause] , I see people struggle with mornings every day. [look at camera] , here's the thing: it’s a single action that shifts the whole rhythm.

First I stop checking my phone immediately [pause], then I set one small intention for the day [pause], and finally I do it without distraction [pause], every single time.

Now go save this idea for later [pause], it might help your routine.
title: The One Habit That Fixed My Mornings
